about_the_game:
MILF Sex Prison: Sector X — the demo version of a perverted sci-fi visual novel where power and lust collide behind the walls of a secret cosmic prison.

In this preview, you’ll experience the beginning of your journey as a freshly appointed warden of Sector X — an experimental facility where the Empress conducts her “re-education” program on the galaxy’s most dangerous and seductive female offenders.

Patrol the corridors, visit the cells, and take part in the first interrogations and inspections. Learn the mechanics of discipline and trust — and feel how quickly control begins to slip through your fingers.

Here, every command can turn into temptation, and every order can end with heavy breathing.

💋 In the demo version you’ll experience:

  • The introduction to the story and your first days as the warden.

  • Interactive mini-games: inspection and cell cleaning.

  • The first two animated 18+ scenes that tease the forbidden pleasures awaiting in the full version.

Welcome to the experiment. The galaxy’s most dangerous criminals are waiting for your command.

content_descriptors.notes: All characters in our game are adults aged 21 or older. This story contains explicit sexual content and is intended solely for mature audiences. Themes explore fetishes such as domination, submission, android intimacy. Encounters may include non-human heroines with cybernetic bodies or animalistic traits, framed as consensual xenophilia within a sci-fi prison setting.
